title: fix(console): the publish-health line shows a finding's customer sentence and folds agent text under technical details
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X4KthxjbE68SmtZYZQBCfuQ)_

Part of #32984 — the console read of ruling 6929121584 (Q1 letter B, parameter 4). The producer side that writes `probes.issues[].userMessage` is #34513. This PR reads the field tolerantly and lands before #34513, so everything below is true on `main` without it: until #34513 lands, no finding carries a `userMessage` and the line shows the generic sentence.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 搭建对话里，发布后的健康提示行不再原样显示写给 AI 的英文检查结果。某条结果带有客户句（`userMessage`，平台的发布检查从 #34513 起开始提供）时，提示行显示这句话。没带时，显示搭建卡已在用的通用提示句（「这次搭建有部分内容需要修复后才能使用……」）。原始的检查文字统一折叠到「技术详情」里。示例数据加载失败也改用语言包里的句子（「示例数据未能加载。」）。首页「全部发布」的提示和 AI 对话里的待发布条，在示例数据加载失败但服务端没给原因时，仍会提示失败，不会误报「全部已上线」。
- 为什么改：维护者裁决 B「出问题的一方写客户句」，界面不再自己维护按错误码翻译的表。
- 风险与回滚：只改这一行的显示方式、两处发布提示判断失败的依据，以及 `publishHealthFromResponse` 读出的字段（新增三个可选字段）。`seedError` 现在只放服务端自己给的文字，可能为空；判断失败要读 `seedFailed`。回滚：revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 的 `PublishHealthLine`，`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/publishHealth.ts`，`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/PendingDraftsBar.tsx` 的 `seedFailed` 判断。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.needsAttention-32984.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/PendingDraftsBar.advisoryReachesAuthor.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/usePublishAllDrafts.refusal-11922.test.tsx`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `publishHealth.ts`: `PublishHealth.issues[]` gains optional `userMessage` and `fix`. Each is read only when it is a non-empty string. `PublishHealth.seedFailed` (optional) marks a failed seed load. `seedError` now holds only the producer's own text, and is absent when the producer sent none. The English 'Sample data failed to load.' the reader used to make up is gone. A seed-loader finding object in `seedApplied.errors[]` now gives its `message`. Before, `String()` turned it into `[object Object]`.
- `PublishHealthLine`: a finding with a `userMessage` shows that sentence on the line. Findings without one get a single generic sentence, the same one the draft-issues block uses (`chatbot.build.issuesSummary` when an error is in the set, else `chatbot.build.warningsSummary`). Every finding's `message` (plus its `fix`) and the seed loader's text go under a closed "Technical details" (`chatbot.build.issuesDetails`). A failed seed reads `chatbot.build.health.seedFailed`.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` (`usePublishAllDrafts`, `PendingDraftsBar`): both read the failed-seed signal as `seedFailed === true || !!seedError`, the rule `PublishHealthLine` reads, instead of `seedError` alone. With no producer text, the toast detail is the line's own sentence, `t('chatbot.build.health.seedFailed')`: both readers hold the i18n `t`, so no new key and no new English. Before this, a failed seed with no producer text reached them as nothing, and the bar said "All pending changes are live."
- `@object-ui/i18n`: one new key, `chatbot.build.health.seedFailed`, in all eleven packs. zh-Hant is generated by `gen:zh-hant`. The existing keys are reused because they fit.
- Seed text: `seedApplied.error` carries engine text (for example `seed apply stopped at the seed for object 'x': …`, or `seed apply: no readable seed bodies`), not a customer sentence. So the line always shows the localized seed sentence, and that text appears only under the details.
- Changeset: names `@object-ui/app-shell` (patch), the changed reading of `seedError` beside "nothing is removed or renamed", and words the customer sentence as conditional on the producer sending it (#34513).

## Tests

- New `describe` in `ChatbotEnhanced.needsAttention-32984.test.tsx` (the shared I18nProvider harness), 6 cases: a finding with a `userMessage` (the sentence is shown, and the agent text and fix appear only in the closed details); one without (zh-Hans generic sentence, agent text only under the details); warnings only; a mixed set; a failed seed in `ja` with loader text kept as a detail; a failed seed with no producer text (zh-Hans sentence, no English, no details).
- New top-level `describe` in `usePublishAllDrafts.refusal-11922.test.tsx` (real hook, real health reader): a batch whose `seedApplied` is `success: false` with no `error` and empty `errors` gives one `home.pendingDrafts.seedWarn` warning whose description is `chatbot.build.health.seedFailed`, and no success toast.
- New top-level `describe` in `PendingDraftsBar.advisoryReachesAuthor.test.tsx` (real bar, real client, real health reader): the same seed answer gives a "Published, but …" warning naming "Sample data failed to load.", and no success toast.
- Existing tests changed by this PR: `ChatbotEnhanced.test.tsx` (round 1) — the existing health cases now assert the new faces, and two new `publishHealthFromResponse` cases cover non-empty-string reads, a loader finding object, and no invented text. No existing test changed in round 2; the two new cases sit in existing harness files.

## Acceptance notes

- The toasts of `usePublishAllDrafts` and `PendingDraftsBar` still print engine text and `issues[].message` verbatim, the same class this PR fixes on the line. That is #34553. This PR fixes only the failure signal in those two readers, not their text.
- Known and left as is: a voiced error (one with a `userMessage`) beside an unvoiced warning gives the error's sentence and the red face.
- The package-less by-reference loop in `usePublishAllDrafts` reads `seedApplied` directly (not through `seedError`) and already reports a failed seed with or without text; it is not changed.

## Verification

- `vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/ packages/i18n/` plus the 38 app-shell test files that name `usePublishAllDrafts`, `PendingDraftsBar` or `publishHealthFromResponse`: Test Files 241 passed (241), Tests 3179 passed, 13 skipped. VERDICT command-exit 0. Narrowed: the full app-shell suite (about 2,300 files) is left to Test UI in CI.
